sourceOfTruthForShape: BrandCandidateDiagnostic in src/pipeline/extractor/field-selection.ts at PR #220 merge commit 546c3f279ce431a1fd8c0203df7a83553ea866ef
reachableVia: the diagnosticSelection candidate array from selectBrandObservationWithCompleteFilterDiagnostics over the exact production pass set. NOT debug.finalSelections, which carries the default shape. See brand-diagnostic-parity-contract.json.
predicatesRecomputedNote: The ACQUISITION consumes the diagnostics PR #220 emits. It does not re-evaluate any predicate, so there is no second implementation that could drift from production. The evaluation harness is not on the acquisition route at all; saying 'the harness consumes' them was wrong and is corrected in Amendment 4.

perCandidatePersisted.candidateOrdinal: non-negative integer, the index in the exact unprojected production candidate array; must be < completeCandidateArrayLength
perCandidatePersisted.completeCandidateArrayLength: positive integer, the unprojected array length for this case
perCandidatePersisted.ocrConfidence: AnalyzerOcrConfidence, persisted whole — all SEVEN fields including missingTokenCount
perCandidatePersisted.regionName: string, the top-level BrandCandidateDiagnostic.regionName; NOT only the copy inside candidateProvenance
perCandidatePersisted.supportPassIds: string[] — the PUBLIC diagnostic support IDs, pre-deduplication-merge. NOT the final merged support set.
perCandidatePersisted.filterReason: BrandLineReason, NEVER null — the REAL production property name. For a rejected candidate it equals activeRejectionReasons[0]; for a kept candidate it is candidate-positive or candidate-plausible.
perCandidatePersisted.ranking: AnalyzerCandidateRanking | null, persisted WHOLE — strategy, orderingMode, comparator, rankingScore and scoreFactors. Persisting only rankingScore would discard the comparator and ordering mode a replay needs.
perCandidatePersisted.filterChecks: complete ordered BrandFilterCheck[], all ten rules
perCandidatePersisted.rankingEligible: boolean, DERIVED from the presence of the ranking object. It means RANKING SEMANTICS WERE COMPUTED, which is not the same as final ranked membership.
perCandidatePersisted.rankingScore: number | null, a convenience copy of ranking.rankingScore; the complete ranking object above remains authoritative
perCandidatePersisted.rankedPosition: integer | null — position in production's FINAL ranked array, which is exactly the set of candidates carrying a decision. Null for a candidate that has ranking semantics but was removed by family reduction or normalized-value deduplication, and null for every rejected candidate.
perCandidatePersisted.selected: boolean, DERIVED by the acquisition from decision
perCandidatePersisted.canonicalRecordSha256: DERIVED. string, full 64 lowercase hex over the canonical preimage in candidate-fingerprint-contract.json

assertions: stable candidate IDs are unique within each case
emitted candidate count equals the unprojected diagnostic-array count
no record is silently overwritten or deduplicated
filterChecks is present on every candidate
activeRejectionReasons is present on every candidate

haltCodes.CANDIDATE_ID_COLLISION: two candidates in one case produced the same stable id, or an ordinal repeated
haltCodes.CANDIDATE_EVIDENCE_TRUNCATED: emitted count does not equal the unprojected diagnostic-array count
haltCodes.COMPLETE_DIAGNOSTICS_ABSENT: the selection carries no brandDiagnostics, or brandDiagnostics.candidates is not an array
haltCodes.BRAND_DIAGNOSTIC_SELECTION_PARITY_FAILUR: the diagnostic selection differs from debug.finalSelections.brand once filterChecks and activeRejectionReasons are removed
haltCodes.MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD: a required own property is absent
haltCodes.UNEXPECTED_FIELD: an undeclared key is present; the schema is closed
haltCodes.FIELD_TYPE_MISMATCH: a field does not satisfy the frozen type or enum
haltCodes.MALFORMED_CANDIDATE_ORDINAL: candidateOrdinal is not a non-negative integer
haltCodes.MALFORMED_ARRAY_LENGTH: completeCandidateArrayLength is not a positive integer
haltCodes.WRONG_CANONICALIZATION_VERSION: canonicalizationVersion does not equal the frozen version
haltCodes.FILTER_LADDER_INVARIANT_VIOLATED: filterChecks, activeRejectionReasons and kept/filterReason are mutually inconsistent
haltCodes.DERIVED_FIELD_INCONSISTENT: rankingEligible, rankingScore or selected is not derivable from ranking or decision
haltCodes.ALREADY_FINALIZED: a derived identity field was present before finalization
haltCodes.DIGEST_DOES_NOT_MATCH_RECORD: the supplied digest does not equal the recomputation over the complete record
haltCodes.PROVENANCE_DISAGREES_WITH_CANDIDATE: a fact the diagnostic states twice disagrees with itself
haltCodes.MALFORMED_OPAQUE_ITEM_ID_AT_ADAPTER: the adapter received an opaqueItemId outside ^item-\d{4}$
haltCodes.KEPT_CANDIDATE_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE: a kept candidate is missing score or ranking, or declares rankingEligible false

storageFormat.layout: one JSONL file per case per run, one JSON object per candidate decision

resolvedLimitation.was: every individual filter check and every active rejection reason were unavailable, because the ladder short-circuits and production recorded only the first firing rule
resolvedLimitation.now: RESOLVED by merged PR #220, which evaluates all ten rules under an evaluation-only, default-off entry point and enforces eight runtime invariants
resolvedLimitation.consequence: For every candidate the complete set of ladder rules that would reject it is recorded. That answers WHY a candidate was rejected. It does NOT by itself answer what the selector would have produced under a different filter, because candidates are constructed from the passes: see region-ocr-result-replay-contract.json, which is what actually underwrites capability 3.
resolvedLimitation.correctionOfPriorConsequenceClaim: Amendment 2 claimed a one-filter counterfactual was 'no longer bounded by unknown later rules' and therefore satisfied. That conflated rejection reasons with replay and is superseded.

historicalNote: An earlier revision of this contract named debug.finalSelections.brand.brandDiagnostics.candidates as the source of complete diagnostics. That was incorrect and is corrected here.
fieldNameCorrection: Amendment 3 named the persisted field authoritativeFilterReason while the real BrandCandidateDiagnostic property and the fingerprint record both used filterReason. One name is kept, and it is production's: filterReason.
absentOptionalNormalizationNote: decision, score and ranking are optional on BrandCandidateDiagnostic. The acquisition writes an explicit null when production omits them, so the canonical key set is identical across every record and a MISSING field can never be mistaken for an absent-and-therefore-omitted one. Omission is rejected; null is valid.

validatesBeforeHashing: every required evidence key is an own property
every field satisfies the frozen type predicate
neither derived identity field is already present
finalizationGate.priorDefect: Amendment 3 had no complete-record schema, so finalizeCandidateRecord accepted { opaqueItemId, candidateOrdinal } and produced a well-formed identity over no evidence.
finalizationGate.priorDefectAmendment4: stableCandidateId checked only that a digest was present, well formed and self-consistent. A caller could hash a two-field partial and pass the result back in; the digest matched because it was computed over exactly that partial. A self-consistent digest over incomplete evidence is still incomplete evidence.

closedKeySetRule.beforeFinalization: the own-key set must EQUAL requiredOwnPropertiesBeforeFinalization exactly
closedKeySetRule.afterFinalization: the own-key set must EQUAL those keys plus canonicalRecordSha256 and stableCandidateId, exactly
closedKeySetRule.why: An open key set would let an undeclared acquisition, truth, debug or convenience property enter the fingerprint silently, so the digest would cover something the contract never described.

crossFieldInvariants: filterChecks contains exactly all ten ladder rules, once each, in frozen order
activeRejectionReasons equals the failed checks in ladder order
a rejected candidate has at least one active reason, and the first equals filterReason
a kept candidate has no active reason and no failed check, and its filterReason is candidate-positive or candidate-plausible

enumValuesAreIncumbentValues.driftGuard: src/fixtures/eval/issue-149-frozen-vocabulary.test.ts asserts every copied vocabulary equals the production constant

brandClassNotPersisted.why: There is no brandClass on BrandCandidateDiagnostic. For a KEPT candidate the distinction is recorded by filterReason: candidate-positive versus candidate-plausible. A REJECTED span returns from analyzeBrandSpan before a Candidate object exists, so production never calculates a brandClass for it and none can be persisted.

referenceAdapter.why: One mapping from BrandCandidateDiagnostic to the persisted record. A second mapping could drift from production's shape without any test noticing.

supportProvenanceLevel.candidateRecordSupportPassIds: the support IDs exposed on the PUBLIC BrandCandidateDiagnostic — that is, the support the candidate had BEFORE any later merge
supportProvenanceLevel.candidateProvenance: the PUBLIC diagnostic provenance, likewise pre-merge
supportProvenanceLevel.whyPreMerge: Production merges support-pass information during candidate deduplication (dedupeBestCandidates -> mergeCandidateSupport, field-selection.ts:466, 2175-2195). The public diagnostic objects are constructed before that, and the only values written back to them afterwards are score, ranking and decision. supportPassIds is never written back.
supportProvenanceLevel.finalSelectionSupportingPassIds: persisted SEPARATELY from FieldSelection.supportingPassIds for the selected observation, where the post-merge value IS exposed

completePostDeduplicationMergedSupportFo.why: The merged support set exists only on the internal Candidate objects inside the ranked array. It is not written back to the public diagnostics and is not otherwise exposed.
completePostDeduplicationMergedSupportFo.notReconstructedWhy: Recomputing the merge outside production would be a second implementation of deduplication, and labelling its output as production's merged support would misstate what the pipeline produced.
completePostDeduplicationMergedSupportFo.wouldRequire: a production change to expose it, which this amendment forbids

supportProvenanceLevel.doNotCall: the candidate-record supportPassIds the final post-deduplication support set for every ranked candidate

finalRankedMembership.membershipIs: the set of candidates whose decision is defined
finalRankedMembership.whyNot: Production assigns ranking semantics to every scored candidate, then reduces them with bestFamilyCandidates and dedupeBestCandidates, sorts the survivors with compareCandidateRanking, and assigns a decision only to that final array (field-selection.ts:2556-2578).
finalRankedMembership.orderedBy: production's exported compareCandidateRanking, applied through a minimal structural wrapper; NOT rankingScore alone
finalRankedMembership.whyNotRankingScoreAlone: The comparator is an ordered list that can prioritise score eligibility, prominence, OCR evidence and normalized value under three ordering modes. Sorting on rankingScore alone reorders prominence-first candidates and breaks equal-score ties differently from production.
finalRankedMembership.tieOrder: the original diagnostic-array order, preserved when the production comparator returns zero
finalRankedMembership.selectedCandidate: exactly one when N > 0, and it must be position 0

haltCodes.RANKED_MEMBERSHIP_INCONSISTENT: a decision without ranking semantics, a rankedPosition without a decision, a decision without a rankedPosition, a selected candidate away from position 0, position 0 held by a non-selected candidate, or a rejected candidate carrying any of the three
haltCodes.RANKED_POSITION_PARITY_FAILURE: positions not unique, not contiguous from 0, more than one selected candidate, or a non-empty ranked set without exactly one selected candidate

finalRankedMembership.arrayLevelInvariantsEnforcedIn: finalizeProductionCandidateArray — a single-record validator cannot prove uniqueness or contiguity, and claiming it could would be an overclaim
finalRankedMembership.priorDefect: An earlier adapter took every diagnostic carrying a ranking, sorted by rankingScore descending, and gave them all positions. That assigned fake positions to deduplicated candidates and produced an order production never produced.

candidateEmissionApi.supersededPropertyPath: diagnosticSelection.candidates — that property does not exist on FieldSelection
candidateEmissionApi.bareCandidateArrayProhibitedWhy: A bare-array parameter let a caller hand over a filtered or truncated population while technically calling the approved function. The adapter now takes the whole selection and reads the population itself.
candidateEmissionApi.prohibitedSymbolsNote: finalizeCandidateRecord and stableCandidateId are prohibited FOR BRAND CANDIDATE EMISSION. The canonical helper remains permitted for pass validation, semantic fingerprinting and exact-byte hashing.
candidateEmissionApi.noRuntimeTestBackdoorNote: TEST_ONLY_candidateAdapterInternals is removed. The adapter exports exactly one candidate-emission function; the lower-level helpers, CandidateAdapterContext and assertRankedArrayInvariants are module-private and unreachable at runtime.

haltCodes.COMPLETE_DIAGNOSTICS_ABSENT: the selection carries no brandDiagnostics, or brandDiagnostics.candidates is not an array
haltCodes.CANDIDATE_EVIDENCE_TRUNCATED: the emitted record count does not equal the complete diagnostic candidate count

everyKeptCandidate: score is non-null and satisfies the complete BrandCandidateScore schema
ranking is non-null and satisfies the complete ranking schema
keptCandidateEvidence.aKeptCandidateMayLackADecision: yes — family reduction or normalized-value deduplication removed it. decision and rankedPosition are then both null while score and ranking remain.
keptCandidateEvidence.why: Production scores and assigns ranking semantics to every kept candidate before family reduction and deduplication (field-selection.ts:2536-2543). A rejected span returns from analyzeBrandSpan before a Candidate object is constructed, so it can carry none of it.
keptCandidateEvidence.priorDefect: The validator permitted a kept candidate with score, ranking, rankingEligible, decision and rankedPosition all null or false, and did not require a rejected candidate's score to be null.

keptPopulationMustRetainARankedSurvivor.relation: (any candidate is kept) === (at least one candidate carries a decision)
keptPopulationMustRetainARankedSurvivor.why: Production always builds a non-empty ranked list and assigns exactly one selected decision whenever kept candidates exist. A kept candidate may individually lack a decision only because family reduction or deduplication removed it — which requires that another kept candidate survived.
whenAtLeastOneKeptCandidate: at least one decision-bearing final ranked member
ranked positions are unique and contiguous
every ranked member carries score and ranking semantics
keptPopulationMustRetainARankedSurvivor.priorGap: The array adapter derived membership from candidates carrying a decision and checked selection only when that set was non-empty. If every kept candidate's decision disappeared, the ranked set was empty and every record still passed.
